App and setup boundaries

Chat runs skills/commands; hooks and sub-agents run in Cowork or Claude Code. Code account sync requires a supported current version. No connector is needed for the practice files.

What you need

Setup instructions

Follow the practical guide

Original installation instructions

  1. Open Customize > Plugins > Discover. Select Data by Anthropic and choose Add; check organisation permissions.
  2. In a fresh chat use the / or + menu to find explore-data. Attach a small authorised file. Expect the workflow to appear before proceeding.
Check before keeping it

Ask for one small result, inspect the output and permissions, and confirm it suits your app. If it fails, undo your changes and return to your original project.
